edge_cases_audited.name: Z-close trigger surface — cashier vs safety-net cron vs auto-open gap
edge_cases_audited.evidence: Three sources of close trigger verified at HEAD beb1e15eb: (1) ZReportController::close at app/Http/Controllers/Admin/Fiscal/ZReportController.php:53-61 — POST /api/admin/fiscal/z-report/close, auth:sanctum + pos-manage-fiscal permission, resolveBranchId requires user.branch_id>0 else 422; (2) FiscalCloseAllActiveBranchesCommand 'fiscal:close-all-active-branches' at app/Console/Commands/FiscalCloseAllActiveBranchesCommand.php:55-162 scheduled by Kernel.php:310-317 dailyAt('23:55')->timezone('Europe/Paris')->onOneServer->withoutOverlapping->runInBackground (G2-HEAL-06 commit c98e94459); (3) artisan ad-hoc via tinker or composer-script. NO UI button exists (grep over resources/js for 'fiscal/z-report/close' → 0 hits; LastZReportWidget.vue:96 only GETs '/admin/fiscal/z-report' for display, never POSTs close). HEALED vs G.6-S2 'manual-only path' P1: cron now exists, dailyAt('23:55') < midnight Paris preserving same business_date. CRITICAL UNHEALED GAP: the safety-net only fires close on branches that ALREADY HAVE an OPEN Z (pre-check FiscalCloseAllActiveBranchesCommand.php:100-103 `where status STATUS_OPEN exists` → if none, skipped with z_close.safety_net.skip + reason 'no_open_z'). ZReport::open() has exactly ONE production caller in the codebase (verified grep: ZReportController.php:48), no auto-open at 00:00, no first-order-of-day open, no scheduled open lane in Kernel.php. For a branch where the cashier never manually presses 'Ouvrir Z' (no UI button exists either — same grep), the safety-net cron is effectively a no-op forever. P0 risk surfaces only IF (a) orders accrue without an OPEN Z, then (b) someone manually opens days later, then (c) the close aggregates an arbitrary multi-day window. Today's aggregate window `(opened_at, closed_at]` will silently span the gap with no warning surface beyond `warnOnOrphanedPaidOrders` (fiscal_sequence_no is allocated at order create for kiosk-paid + at close for POS cash, so most rows will be present — the window is just wider than expected).
edge_cases_audited.remediation_recommended: Either (a) ship a 'Ouvrir Z' Vue button + complementary auto-open scheduler lane (Kernel.php dailyAt('00:00') open if no OPEN Z exists for branch with activity), or (b) auto-open inside FiscalCloseAllActiveBranchesCommand when no OPEN Z + activity in last 24h (re-uses the canonical activeBranchIds helper + warns if window > 36h). Owner-gate per G6-OG-1 still pending.

edge_cases_audited.name: ZReportService.close cascade — pre-flight + aggregate + sign + persist + log
edge_cases_audited.evidence: ZReportService::close at app/Services/Fiscal/ZReportService.php:180-286 cascade re-walked at HEAD: (1) Cache::lock('z_report_b{n}', 10s).block(4s) :191-195 — concurrency primary; (2) DB::transaction wraps body :203-268 — atomicity; (3) `STATUS_OPEN`-row fetched with `lockForUpdate` :204-208 — defense vs interleaved close; (4) `verifyChain($branchId)` :201 — Phase 1 chain integrity (Z-only, legacy), CALLED but NOT strict by default on local (config('fiscal.verify_chain_strict')); (5) `assertChainIntegrity` via lazy FiscalChainValidator IS NOT CALLED inside close() — only inside open() at :95. Asymmetry confirmed by re-grep. This was Phase B.5 brief assertion 'asserts BEFORE extending'; verified only HALF holds — open() asserts both chains, close() asserts only Z-chain in non-strict mode; (6) `warnOnOrphanedPaidOrders` :229 — kiosk-paid orders missing fiscal_sequence_no in window are LOGGED as warn (`fiscal.z_report.orphan_paid_in_window`), correctly EXCLUDED from aggregate; (7) `aggregate(branchId, opened_at, closedAt)` :231 — half-open `(from, to]` window, fiscal_sequence_no IS NOT NULL filter, payment_status != UNPAID filter, BranchScope bypassed via `withoutGlobalScope`, `withTrashed()` per P0-FIX-1/2; (8) `prevHash` read from latest STATUS_CLOSED row of branch ordered by sequence_no desc :233-237; (9) `sign(branchId, prevHash, sequence_no, aggregates, closedAt)` :239 → FiscalSealingService::signZReport — HMAC-SHA256 chained via ksort(aggregates) + UTC ISO-8601 closed_at canonicalisation (POS-9-H.2.7 / F-B4 timezone-stable); (10) `forceFill + save` :241-247 persists aggregates + prev_hash + signature + status='closed'; (11) `Log::channel('fiscal')->info('z_report.close', [...])` :253-265 — file-channel structured log. GAP: NO call to `AuditLogService::write(['action' => 'z_report.closed', ...])` inside ZReportService::close. Verified by grep: `grep audit_logs|AuditLogService app/Services/Fiscal/ZReportService.php` returns only a comment at :91 mentioning audit_logs validation, NEVER a write. ZReport model app/Models/ZReport.php has NO observer (verified by grep User::observe pattern only). EventServiceProvider.php has NO ZReport-related event listener. So `audit_logs` HMAC chain does NOT contain a 'z_report.closed' row per Z; the spec K.7.2 line is aspirational. Fiscal integrity remains intact (z_reports has its OWN HMAC chain independent of audit_logs), but cross-chain forensic correlation (e.g. 'which audit_logs cash.session.* events were sealed in Z #N') has no direct anchor.
edge_cases_audited.remediation_recommended: Inside ZReportService::close, after the forceFill+save at line 247 (still inside DB::transaction so it shares atomicity), add `app(AuditLogService::class)->write(['branch_id' => $branchId, 'action' => 'z_report.closed', 'resource' => 'z_report', 'resource_id' => $open->id, 'payload' => ['sequence_no' => $open->sequence_no, 'total_ttc' => (float) $aggregates['total_ttc'], 'order_count' => (int) $aggregates['order_count'], 'cancel_count' => (int) $aggregates['cancel_count'], 'refund_count' => (int) $aggregates['refund_count'], 'signature_prefix' => substr($signature, 0, 12)]])`. Touches FROZEN file — owner LOCK_FISCAL required. ≤1h effort + 1 new sentinel test.

edge_cases_audited.name: Per-branch independent close — Cache::lock + sequence_no monotonic
edge_cases_audited.evidence: Per-branch isolation guaranteed at three layers: (a) lock key `z_report_b{branchId}` at ZReportService.php:191 — distinct branches acquire distinct Redis locks, never contend; (b) STATUS_OPEN query keyed by `branch_id` at :205, `lockForUpdate` is a row-level pessimistic lock on the open Z of THAT branch only; (c) `sequence_no` allocation at open uses `ZReport::where('branch_id', $branchId)->max('sequence_no') + 1` at :112-114 — strictly per-branch monotonic. CRITICAL CONFIRMATION: NO global Cache::lock across branches, NO global sequence. Branch 1 close in flight does NOT block branch 2 close — exactly the desired multi-tenant behavior. V1 single-branch (Le Cayenne id=1) hits this code with the same primitives, so the V2 multi-branch SaaS uplift requires no refactor in this layer. FiscalCloseAllActiveBranchesCommand.php:88-147 iterates `Kernel::activeBranchIds()` sequentially in PHP — per-branch try/catch envelope :124-146 isolates failure (one branch crash sets $failed++, continues loop, command exits SUCCESS unless any failed). Mirror pattern in `fiscal-chain-monitor-all-branches` at Kernel.php:211-245. WAVE 2d FISCAL-ADV3C-01 helper `Kernel::activeBranchIds()` at :358-365 uses `whereIn('status', [Status::ACTIVE, 1])` — accepts both pre- and post-migration sentinels, no silent skip.

edge_cases_audited.name: Z-close post I2-HEAL-01 OrderCanceled cascade — cancel & loyalty clawback in Z totals
edge_cases_audited.evidence: (a) CANCEL counting: ZReportService::aggregate at :337-409 splits into TWO buckets — `$preZCancelCount` :377-379 (orders created+canceled inside the window — CANCELED, REJECTED, RETURNED), and post-Z adjustment :386-402 (orders created BEFORE window, canceled inside window via `created_at <= $from AND updated_at > $from AND updated_at <= $to`). Post-Z cancels apply NEGATIVE delta to totals via `applyOrderToTotals(o, -1, ...)` at :400. Cancel_count = preZ + postZ counts at :404; refund_count = preZ RETURNED + postZ RETURNED at :405. Cancel cascades via OrderCanceled event (app/Events/OrderCanceled.php) → ReleaseStockOnOrderCanceled + ReleaseAvailabilityOnOrderCanceled (EventServiceProvider.php:170-173) — NEITHER touches z_reports or audit_logs. So a cancel reflects in Z via the orders.status flip + the aggregate window logic alone, NOT via any side-channel. VERIFIED correct counting. (b) LOYALTY CLAWBACK: spec K.7.4 phrasing 'Loyalty clawback events count in audit_logs delta correctly' rests on a WRONG ASSUMPTION. Verified: LoyaltyService::clawbackEarnedPoints at app/Services/LoyaltyService.php:141-199 writes (i) `loyalty_transactions` row type='manual_deduct', (ii) `users.loyalty_points` decremented to new_balance, (iii) `Log::info('[Loyalty] Earned points clawed back on refund', ...)`. NO call to AuditLogService::write anywhere in LoyaltyService.php (verified grep). Z aggregation reads ONLY `orders.total`, `orders.total_ht`, `orders.total_tax`, `orders.pos_payment_method` in applyOrderToTotals at :630-638 — NEVER joins loyalty_transactions or audit_logs. Loyalty points are NOT revenue (€ value of points stays customer-owned debt, not booked sales) — they DO NOT enter Z totals. So clawback does not need a 'delta' in audit_logs; the spec phrasing conflates two independent chains. Cancel reflects in Z via the orders.status state machine alone (post-Z adjustment window in aggregate). Loyalty clawback reflects in user-balance only, fully INDEPENDENT of Z aggregate.
edge_cases_audited.spec_correction: K.7.4 'Loyalty clawback events count in audit_logs delta correctly' should read 'Loyalty clawback events DO NOT enter Z totals (points are not revenue). They are recorded in loyalty_transactions + Log channel only.' The audit_logs chain has no loyalty entries today; this is by design.

edge_cases_audited.name: Z-close post J2-HEAL-06 composition_snapshot trigger — immutability honored
edge_cases_audited.evidence: Migration 2026_05_24_040211_add_composition_snapshot_immutability_trigger.php verified at HEAD: MySQL trigger `order_items_composition_snapshot_no_update` BEFORE UPDATE SIGNALs SQLSTATE 45000 when NEW.composition_snapshot != OLD.composition_snapshot and both NON-NULL, also SIGNALs when NULL replaces a non-null (lines 86-101). SQLite parity branch at :107-133 uses two triggers (`_no_update` + `_no_null`) with WHEN clauses + RAISE(ABORT). down() refuses execution in production at :139-142. Cross-impact on Z-close cascade: Z aggregate reads composition_snapshot indirectly via taxBreakdownForOrders at :645-668 — `SELECT tax_rate, SUM(tax_amount) FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (...) AND tax_rate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tax_rate`. NEVER reads `composition_snapshot` directly. So the trigger HARDENS the upstream immutability that Z aggregation does NOT consume; it protects against a future drift where someone tries to alter snapshots POST-Z (the row stays sealed via SealedOrderGuard app/Services/Order/SealedOrderGuard.php:34-64 + the DB trigger as belt-and-braces). Pre-J2-HEAL-06 the only protection was the Eloquent-layer SealedOrderGuard; now DB-level enforcement covers raw SQL UPDATE bypass + compromised insider scenarios. Z totals match because the snapshot byte-for-byte is now DB-locked once non-null. NF525 fiscal integrity hardened, no functional regression.

edge_cases_audited.name: Empty-day Z-close — two distinct present-state behaviors
edge_cases_audited.evidence: Path A (cashier opened Z at 09:00, zero orders all day): safety-net 23:55 finds STATUS_OPEN exists → bypasses skip pre-check → enters `try { $service->close($branchId); } catch ...` at FiscalCloseAllActiveBranchesCommand.php:124-146 → ZReportService::close inside transaction → aggregate returns `['total_ttc' => 0.00, 'total_ht' => 0.00, 'total_tva' => 0.00, 'total_by_method' => [], 'total_by_tax_rate' => [], 'order_count' => 0, 'cancel_count' => 0, 'refund_count' => 0]` (verified at ZReportService::aggregate :355-358 collection is empty, the foreach loop at :366-369 simply doesn't iterate). Then signature = HMAC(secret, branchId|prevHash|sequence_no|{ksorted-empty-aggregates}|UTC closed_at) — deterministic on the same inputs, signs a 'witness' Z that proves nothing happened that day. Row INSERTed with sequence_no monotonic, prev_hash chained. NF525 chain extends correctly, audit_logs unaffected (per K.7.2 no audit_logs entry written today). Path B (cashier NEVER opened Z): safety-net pre-check at :100-103 `where status STATUS_OPEN exists` → false → skip with `z_close.safety_net.skip` info-log + reason 'no_open_z' → continues to next branch. NO row created in z_reports. NO chain advancement. This is the K.7.1 gap surfacing here: a dark day genuinely produces no Z row at all. CONSEQUENCE: a 7-day vacation closure where cashier never opens Z produces ZERO Z rows during that window. The chain's sequence_no will jump from N (last day pre-vacation) to N+1 (first day post-vacation) — but `verifyChain` at :463-572 uses `$expectedSequenceNo = $previousSequenceNo + 1` at :541, which is satisfied because there was no intermediate row to skip. The dark-day skip is INVISIBLE to verifyChain. Both paths are NF525-safe at the chain layer; only operational visibility differs.
edge_cases_audited.operational_note: Empty-day Z row (Path A) creates a signed witness — useful for audit ('we were open, no sales'). Dark-day skip (Path B) leaves no trace beyond fiscal-channel log — auditors must read logs to know branch was inactive.

edge_cases_audited.name: Admin dashboard widget update post-close — LastZReportWidget refresh semantics
edge_cases_audited.evidence: LastZReportWidget.vue at resources/js/components/admin/dashboard/LastZReportWidget.vue verified: (a) `mounted()` :62-74 calls `fetchReports()` ONCE on mount (gated by `canFetchReports()` permission check `transactions` URL/access aligned with transactionRoutes.js); (b) `fetchReports()` :91-110 does `axios.get('admin/fiscal/z-report')` → backend ZReportController::index at :22-41 returns top 100 ordered by sequence_no desc, scoped by `resolveBranchIdForRead` (admin sees all, staff sees own branch — Wave T R1 F1 P0 2026-05-20); (c) widget displays first `status === 'closed'` row OR `rows[0]` :102-103. NO Echo subscription, NO setInterval, NO router-aware refresh. Consequence: when safety-net cron closes Z at 23:55, the widget will NOT reflect until next page-load / route-mount. S7-MEGA-F1 finding mentioned 'V1.0.2 backlog FiscalChainStatusWidget' — verified that widget does NOT exist in resources/js at HEAD (no FiscalChainStatusWidget.vue). NF525 critical surface (chain status, last verify timestamp, errors count) is NOT visualized today. Per G.6 + S7 prior agents: widget displays last Z basic info only (sequence_no, status, closed_at, opened_at fallback). The dashboard component DashboardComponent.vue mounts the widget but does not pipe Echo events into it. Owner gate.

Quarterly snapshot rotation at RunDailyBackup.php:330-363 copies daily-YYYY-MM-DD.sql.gz → quarterly-YYYY-QN.sql.gz on Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct day-1, 24-quarter (6-year NF525) retention enforced at :378. edge_cases_audited.name: Failure recovery — Z-close mid-cascade error path
edge_cases_audited.evidence: ZReportService::close at :180-286 wrapped in DB::transaction at :203-268 — closure body atomicity guaranteed. Failure modes audited: (a) verifyChain at :201 throws if chain broken AND strict mode (Config::get('fiscal.verify_chain_strict') default=production-true): RuntimeException at :562, NEVER enters DB::transaction → no row mutated. (b) lockForUpdate fails (rare — DB deadlock): QueryException bubbles up → ROLLBACK → outer try/catch at :275-285 logs 'failure' on stack channel, rethrows. (c) `assertNoPendingClose` at :147-174 — disabled until STATUS_CLOSING constant is defined (verified ZReport.php:15-16 only STATUS_OPEN + STATUS_CLOSED defined). Currently a NO-OP. (d) Aggregate query crashes (e.g. corrupt order row): exception bubbles up inside DB::transaction → ROLLBACK → STATUS_OPEN row STAYS OPEN, sequence_no NOT advanced. Retry-safe. (e) sign() failure (FiscalSealingService secret rotation mid-call): same path, ROLLBACK. (f) forceFill+save fails (DB constraint): ROLLBACK. (g) Log::channel('fiscal')->info :253 succeeds after save — non-critical; even if log fails (try/catch at outer-finally :281-284), the save commit already happened. CRITICAL: there is NO `audit_logs` write inside the transaction (K.7.2 gap), so the 'audit_logs guard refuses appending without valid prev_hash' phrase from the brief is moot — no append happens at Z-close in current code. AuditLogService::write IS invoked elsewhere (cash drawer ops, item availability, etc.) and DOES refuse via UNIQUE(branch_id, prev_hash) violations + retry-once pattern at :60-65 of audit-chain idempotent recovery. If a hypothetical future K.7.2 patch wires a z_report.closed audit row, it would inherit that defense-in-depth.

edge_cases_audited.name: Double-close blocked — idempotent via STATUS_OPEN pre-check
edge_cases_audited.evidence: Three layers of double-close defense verified at HEAD: (a) FiscalCloseAllActiveBranchesCommand.php:100-113 — pre-check `where status STATUS_OPEN exists` BEFORE calling service.close; if no OPEN Z (because cashier already closed earlier), skips with info-log 'z_close.safety_net.skip' + reason 'no_open_z'. NO error pager, NO exception. (b) ZReportService::close :204-212 — inside DB::transaction with `lockForUpdate`: if no STATUS_OPEN row found, throws RuntimeException 'no open Z report to close for branch {N}'. So a manual + cron race where BOTH find OPEN, BOTH acquire Cache::lock sequentially (Cache::lock is exclusive per key) → first wins, second enters transaction with STATUS_OPEN row absent → throws. (c) Cache::lock('z_report_b{n}', 10s).block(4s) :191-195 — outermost serialization: even if pre-check passes for both, only one acquires the lock; the other blocks 4s, then RuntimeException 'cannot acquire'. Pattern is idempotent in the cashier+cron-co-fire scenario by design. F.10 verified 13/13 invariants including double-close blocked. NO regression at HEAD. CRON misfire scenarios (double-trigger) safe: `onOneServer + withoutOverlapping` at Kernel.php:315-316 + the three layers above.

edge_cases_audited.name: Sync cascade after Z-close — Echo broadcast & cross-surface notification
edge_cases_audited.verdict: AMBER — NO ZReportClosed EVENT, NO BROADCAST
edge_cases_audited.evidence: Verified exhaustively: (a) `ZReportClosed` event class DOES NOT EXIST in app/Events/ (grep app/Events/ → list shows OrderCanceled, OrderCreated, OrderPaidAtCounter, OrderPaymentStatusChanged, OrderStatusChanged, OrderTableChanged, RefundCreated, BranchStatusChanged, CatalogChanged, CategoryCreated/Updated/Deleted, ItemCreated/Updated/Deleted, ItemAvailabilityChanged, ItemExtraAvailabilityChanged, ItemVariationAvailabilityChanged, IngredientAvailabilityChanged, ComposerProfileChanged, CouponChanged, StockLevelChanged, SettingsUpdated, OutboxBroadcastSwallowedEvent, Send* notifications. NO ZReport*). Confirmed by I.4 finding I4-listener-ordering: ZReport produces no events. (b) ZReportCashEnrichmentService.php:286-290 docblock acknowledges 'no ZReportClosed event in the codebase yet, so no listener is wired'. (c) EventServiceProvider.php has NO ZReport entry in `$listen` array. (d) ZReportService::close only writes Log::channel('fiscal')->info('z_report.close', ...) at :253. (e) FiscalCloseAllActiveBranchesCommand writes Log::channel('fiscal')->info('z_close.safety_net.success', ...) at :128-133 — file channel, NOT a domain event. CONSEQUENCE: POS / KDS / Kiosk / Mobile / Web do NOT receive any realtime signal that Z was closed. Cross-surface notification of close is invisible until next axios poll (LastZReportWidget mounts page-reload — see K.7.7). For V1 single-cashier Le Cayenne single-branch this is operationally acceptable (cashier IS the trigger so they know already), but multi-cashier V2 SaaS will need this. CRITICAL FOR K.7.7: even if widget refresh existed, there is no event to subscribe to. ZReportCashEnrichmentService::persistForClosedReport at :235-267 is the ONE place a 'post-close enrichment' would naturally hook, but verified by grep: ZERO production callers (only mentioned in proposals/, reports/, and itself). The cash enrichment is dead-code in production — z_reports.cash_opening_amount + cash_closing_amount + cash_variance + cash_movements_count remain NULL today, and the dashboard widget never displays them.
edge_cases_audited.remediation_recommended: (a) Create app/Events/ZReportClosed event class (with branch_id, z_report_id, sequence_no, signature_prefix); (b) Dispatch from ZReportService::close after save (still inside transaction via DispatchableAfterCommit); (c) Wire ZReportCashEnrichmentService::persistForClosedReport as a listener on ZReportClosed (closes the dead-code gap K.7.12 surfaces); (d) Optionally broadcast on private-branch.{id} so LastZReportWidget can refresh. Touches FROZEN ZReportService — owner LOCK_FISCAL required. ≤4h effort + sentinel + visual test.

findings.title: Z-close safety-net cron only HALF-closes the operational gap — auto-open is missing
findings.evidence_path: app/Console/Commands/FiscalCloseAllActiveBranchesCommand.php:100-113 (STATUS_OPEN pre-check skips if no open Z) + grep ZReport::open over app/ shows only 1 production caller (ZReportController.php:48) + zero scheduled open lane in Kernel.php
findings.impact: If a cashier forgets to manually 'Ouvrir Z' (and there is no UI button to do so), the safety-net cron skips every night with 'no_open_z'. Orders without an OPEN Z still get fiscal_sequence_no allocated at create (kiosk-paid) but accumulate in a phantom non-window. When someone eventually opens AND closes manually days later, the aggregate window covers a wide multi-day span. Chain integrity holds, but operational expectation of 'one Z per day' is broken.
findings.recommendation: Ship 'Ouvrir Z' Vue button PLUS auto-open cron at Kernel.php dailyAt('00:01') Europe/Paris that opens a fresh Z if (no STATUS_OPEN exists for branch AND activity in last 24h via orders.created_at > yesterday). Pattern mirrors FiscalCloseAllActiveBranchesCommand. Effort ≤3h.

findings.title: Z-close does NOT write an audit_logs HMAC chain entry
findings.evidence_path: app/Services/Fiscal/ZReportService.php:253-265 only writes Log::channel('fiscal') file-channel info, NO AuditLogService::write call. ZReport model has no observer. EventServiceProvider has no ZReport listener.
findings.impact: z_reports has its OWN HMAC chain (chain integrity GREEN), but cross-chain forensic correlation between 'which cash.session.* / order.refunded / item.unavailable rows were sealed in Z #N' is missing. Auditor querying audit_logs cannot find a 'z_report.closed' anchor row. Spec K.7.2 phrasing 'audit_logs entry z_report.closed' was aspirational, not present-state.
findings.recommendation: Add AuditLogService::write call inside ZReportService::close DB::transaction after the forceFill+save (still inside frozen file; owner LOCK_FISCAL required). Payload: branch_id, action='z_report.closed', resource='z_report', resource_id=z.id, payload={sequence_no, total_ttc, order_count, cancel_count, refund_count, signature_prefix}. ≤1h + 1 sentinel test.

findings.title: ZReportCashEnrichmentService::persistForClosedReport has ZERO production callers
findings.evidence_path: grep persistForClosedReport across app/ + routes/ + jobs/ + observers/ + listeners/ + EventServiceProvider returns ONLY the service definition itself + 2 docblock references + test files + proposals. NO production code invokes it.
findings.impact: z_reports.cash_opening_amount + cash_closing_amount + cash_variance + cash_movements_count are NEVER populated in production today. The decorator pattern works but is never invoked. Owner / G.6-S3 assumption that cash enrichment populates these columns is wrong at HEAD. LastZReportWidget would have nothing to display even if it queried them.
findings.recommendation: Wire persistForClosedReport as a listener on a new ZReportClosed event (K.7-FIND-5), OR call it synchronously at end of ZReportService::close (frozen — owner LOCK required). The simpler V1 patch is end-of-close synchronous call inside the transaction. ≤2h.

findings.title: LastZReportWidget polls once on mount — no realtime refresh after Z-close
findings.evidence_path: resources/js/components/admin/dashboard/LastZReportWidget.vue:62-74 mounted() → fetchReports() called ONCE. No Echo subscribe, no setInterval, no router refresh.
findings.impact: Admin sessions left open across midnight (or simply across the safety-net cron firing) display yesterday's Z status. The widget shows stale data with no visible indication. S7-MEGA-F1 already flagged FiscalChainStatusWidget as V1.0.2 backlog; this is the lesser sibling that affects an existing surface.
findings.recommendation: Add 60s setInterval poll in mounted() + clearInterval in beforeUnmount(). OR subscribe to Echo when K.7-FIND-5 ZReportClosed event lands. ≤1h.

findings.title: No ZReportClosed domain event — POS / KDS / Kiosk / Mobile / Web receive no realtime signal of Z-close
findings.evidence_path: grep app/Events/ZReportClosed* + grep ZReportClosed across app/ returns ONLY the ZReportCashEnrichmentService docblock at line 288 explicitly acknowledging absence.
findings.impact: No surface knows in realtime that a Z was closed. Operationally acceptable for V1 single-cashier (cashier IS the trigger), but blocks K.7-FIND-3 wiring (cash enrichment listener) and K.7-FIND-4 widget realtime. Multi-cashier V2 SaaS critical gap.
findings.recommendation: Create app/Events/ZReportClosed with (branch_id, z_report_id, sequence_no, signature_prefix). Dispatch from ZReportService::close after save via DispatchableAfterCommit trait. Wire 2 listeners: (1) persistForClosedReport (K.7-FIND-3), (2) PersistZReportClosedToOutbox for broadcast. ≤4h.

findings.title: K.7.4 spec phrasing 'Loyalty clawback events count in audit_logs delta correctly' rests on wrong assumption
findings.evidence_path: app/Services/LoyaltyService.php:141-199 (clawbackEarnedPoints writes loyalty_transactions + users + Log, NEVER audit_logs) + app/Services/Fiscal/ZReportService.php:630-638 (applyOrderToTotals reads orders.total/total_ht/total_tax/pos_payment_method only, never loyalty_transactions or audit_logs)
findings.impact: Documentation drift. Loyalty points are not revenue; clawback does not affect Z totals. Brief should clarify: 'cancellation reflects in Z via the orders.status state machine alone (post-Z adjustment window in aggregate at :386-402). Loyalty clawback reflects in user-balance and loyalty_transactions ledger only.'
findings.recommendation: Update GOAL brief language. No code change.

factual_corrections_to_brief.actual_state: Not present at HEAD. ZReportService::close writes Log::channel('fiscal')->info('z_report.close') file-channel only. NO audit_logs HMAC chain entry. ZReport model has no observer. EventServiceProvider has no ZReport listener.

factual_corrections_to_brief.brief_line: K.7.2 'assertChainIntegrity called BEFORE extending (refuses extending broken chain per Phase B.5 verified)'
factual_corrections_to_brief.actual_state: assertChainIntegrity is called inside ZReportService::open() at line 95 (verified) — NOT inside close(). Close() only calls verifyChain (Z-chain only, non-strict on non-production) at line 201. The Phase B.5 invariant holds at open but is ASYMMETRIC at close.

factual_corrections_to_brief.brief_line: K.7.4 'Loyalty clawback events count in audit_logs delta correctly'
factual_corrections_to_brief.actual_state: Loyalty clawback writes loyalty_transactions + users + Log channel, NEVER audit_logs. Z aggregation never reads loyalty_transactions or audit_logs. Loyalty is not revenue; clawback does not enter Z totals at all. Brief framing rests on wrong assumption.

factual_corrections_to_brief.brief_line: K.7.6 'skips per safety-net cron with dry-run option G2-HEAL-06: scanned=5 dark/skipped'
factual_corrections_to_brief.actual_state: Two distinct empty-day behaviors: Path A (cashier opened Z, zero orders) → safety-net CLOSES with all-zero aggregates + valid signature + chain extends. Path B (cashier never opened) → safety-net SKIPS with 'no_open_z'. Only Path B produces no row. K.7.6 is correct that dry-run reports skip but the present-state has TWO paths to document.

factual_corrections_to_brief.brief_line: K.7.7 'widget may not show chain status (S7-MEGA-F1 V1.0.2 backlog FiscalChainStatusWidget)'
factual_corrections_to_brief.actual_state: Verified — FiscalChainStatusWidget does NOT exist at HEAD (grep resources/js). LastZReportWidget displays only sequence_no + status + closed_at. Polls once on mount, no realtime refresh.

factual_corrections_to_brief.brief_line: K.7.12 'ZReportClosed event mentioned in spec but doesn't exist per I.4 finding'
factual_corrections_to_brief.actual_state: VERIFIED CORRECT — I.4 finding stands. No ZReportClosed event, no listener, no broadcast. Only Log::channel('fiscal') file-channel entry. Cross-surface notification of close is invisible until next poll/page-load.
